title: Panggilan Nyang Hana Dideungoe di Nanggroe Sombong .
intro: Kamoe meudong lam reruntohan peradaban nyang yoh masa dilee rayeuk, dipat kekuasaan dan keusombongan hana meuteupeue bataih. Sidroe utosan jijak-jak lamkawan awaknyan sira jilakée ubak keubeunaran, teuma até awaknyan teutab kreueh ulée. Peuingat nyan hana jitem deungoe, dan langet keudroe jeuet keu alat beungeh. Soe kheueh utusan nyan, dan peue nyang teujadi ateueh ureuëng-ureuëng nyang jitulak panggilan nyan?
clues: Ulôn geukirém ubak saboh bansa nyang teuga jih hana meutandingan dan nyang jipeudong saboh tugu di tieb-tieb teumpat nyang manyang.
Umat ​​Lôn jianggab droe jihnyan hana hase jipeutaloe dan jipeugah, 'Soe kheueh nyang leubeh teuga nibak geutanyoe?'
Ulôn tawök awaknyan mangat jiseumah Allah mantong, teuma awaknyan jitudoh ulôn bangai dan sulet.
Awaknyan jitanjong ulôn mangat lôn ba huköman nyang ka ulôn janji meunyoe ulôn beutôi.
Allah geukirém ateueh awaknyan angen nyang hana meu-ulang-ulang nyang hana jipeu-ingat sapeue-sapeue nyang jiteuka ateueh awaknyan.
Ulôn dan ureuëng-ureuëng nyang meuiman meusajan ngon ulôn ka geupeuseulamat lé rahmat Allah, seudangkan ureuëng-ureuëng nyang kaphé ka habéh binasa.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Saboh angen nyang binasa jipeuhanco ureueng-ureueng nyang kaphé .
Saboh su nyang kreueh jidrob ureueng-ureueng kaphe .
trial.answer: Saboh angen nyang binasa jipeuhanco ureueng-ureueng nyang kaphé .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Hud ngön ureueng-ureueng meuiman geupeuseulamat, dan ureueng-ureueng kaphé binasa .
Hud geu peu ek keu stasiun nyang manyang .
Hud geutinggai umat gobnyan sigohlom na hukoman .
outcome.answer: Hud ngön ureueng-ureueng meuiman geupeuseulamat, dan ureueng-ureueng kaphé binasa .

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)
